evals.prompt: Help me sharpen the value proposition of our robo-advisor for first-time investors versus keeping money in a savings account.
evals.expected_output: Customer profile, value map, fit matrix, differentiation versus the savings account, two or three proposition statements and an evidence plan.
expectations: Each pain reliever maps to a named customer pain
Doing nothing or a savings account is treated as the competitive alternative
Rankings are evidenced or marked as assumptions
Flags that financial promises need compliance review
